description: SAML service-provider support and enterprise SSO integration for realms that require it.

requirements.description: Realms must optionally support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, enabling enterprise SSO. Configuration per realm includes: IdP metadata URL or XML, attribute mapping (NameID → email, display name, groups), and SP metadata publication. SAML assertions must be validated (signature, conditions, audience, expiry). The resulting local session and token issuance must be identical to other authentication methods.
requirements.deferred_reason: Enterprise SAML is outside the local household and delegated-principal scope of this plan.
requirements.revisit_trigger: An enterprise deployment requires SAML service-provider integration.
requirements.title: SAML 2.0 Service Provider Support and Enterprise SSO Integration
